🇲🇽📈 <u>RETAIL SALES GREW IN ALL 32 MEXICAN STATES THROUGH MAY — INEGI</u>

Every one of Mexico's 32 states posted annual growth in retail sales in the first five months of 2026, INEGI data cited by El Economista shows.

CDMX leads at 4.98%, followed by Puebla (4.11%), Quintana Roo (4.03%), Colima (3.85%) and Querétaro (3.83%). Eighteen states grew above 3.5% — and even the lowest, Oaxaca, posted 2.87%.

While the commentary class sells uncertainty, Mexican households keep spending.

🇲🇽🌾 <u>SHEINBAUM DELIVERS FREE FERTILIZER TO MORELOS CANE GROWERS, MAKES PROGRAM PERMANENT</u>

In Zacatepec, Morelos, President Sheinbaum delivered Producción para el Bienestar and Fertilizantes Gratuitos to sugarcane growers — and made both permanent for the sector, extending programs originally created for corn farmers.

The backing is already paying off: Mexico recovered its US sugar export quota, with 1.2 million tons to be shipped starting next cycle, lifting the price of Mexican sugar and growers' incomes.

"Government, mills and growers at one table, all pulling together for the benefit of those who have least — that is our project," she said.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>CUBA RESISTS: "SILENT GENOCIDE" DENOUNCED FROM MEXICO</u>

On the 73rd anniversary of the Moncada assault, Mexican solidarity organizations and the José Martí Association of Cubans Resident in Mexico gathered in Mexico City with one message: Cuba is enduring a "silent genocide."

"Not with bombs like Gaza, but a silent genocide where an entire people — 10 million Cubans — is denied the minimum conditions of life," said Olivia Garza, the association's vice president, citing blackouts of over 25 hours a day and more than 120,000 patients waiting for hospital care.

The blockade is the weapon. Resistance is the answer.
